producers.name: Domaine P. et M. Jacqueson
producers.intro: 1946年 Henri Jacqueson 在 Rully 建庄。Paul 于1971年加入；Marie 于2006年、Pierre 于2015年接棒。酒庄以 Rully 的红白单地块酒为核心。
producers.scope: 已核对酒庄现行目录与可读取技术单；无年份资料按酒款级记录，文件日期与葡萄酒年份分开。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: 1946年 Henri Jacqueson 在 Rully 建庄。Paul 于1971年加入；Marie 于2006年、Pierre 于2015年接棒。酒庄以 Rully 的红白单地块酒为核心。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 约18 ha，分布 Rully、Mercurey、Bouzeron。面积与栽植年在酒款档案中逐项列明。

sections.title: 栽培与采收
sections.text: 人工采收与分选；成熟度和健康状况决定采收及压榨处理。红葡萄用小箱运输。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 橡木桶熟成，白酒轻过滤；红酒逐桶蛋清澄清后不经过滤装瓶。新桶比例与时间以各酒技术单为准。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 官网列12款：7款白酒、5款红酒；另保留进口商通称 Rully Rouge。新增的无单一地块一级园白酒来自外购葡萄汁。

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: La Barre、Fromanges、La Crée 三地块调配；东向，褐色钙质土及黏土坡积物。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨及重力澄清，桶发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15–20%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 官方新技术单列三地块；此前进口商的两地块描述属于较早资料。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2024-03，不是酒款年份。

en.place: Blend of La Barre, Fromanges and La Crée; east-facing brown calcareous soils and clay colluvium.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed and gravity-settled; barrel fermentation;12 months entirely in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: The current sheet identifies three parcels; the older importer account named only two.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2024-03 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: 进口商列出的 Rully 村庄级 Pinot Noir；未注明单一地块。
wines.method: 酒庄红酒共通工艺为橡木桶熟成、逐桶蛋清澄清及不经过滤装瓶；本条没有可对应的独立技术单。
wines.detail: 保留为进口商所列的独立名称。当前酒庄目录单列 La Barre、Les Chaponnières 及一级园红酒，没有单列此通称；尚无证据将它与某一单地块酒合并。
wines.vintageScope: 进口商目录身份；当前具体发行年份及与单地块标签的关系未确定。

en.place: Importer-listed village Rully Pinot Noir, without a named parcel.
en.method: Estate-wide red-wine practice is oak maturation, barrel-by-barrel egg-white fining and unfiltered bottling; no separate technical sheet is assigned to this entry.
en.detail: Preserved as the importer’s generic label. The current estate menu lists named village reds instead; there is insufficient evidence to merge this entry with La Barre or Les Chaponnières.
en.vintageScope: Importer catalogue identity; current release and continuity with named labels are unestablished.

wines.reviewScope: importer-listed identity; current label continuity not established

wines.name: Rully Rouge La Barre
wines.place: 0.85 ha，1992年栽植，Agneux 洞穴附近高台；西向，红褐色钙质土与黏土。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、去梗、重力入罐；冷浸3–6日，浸渍发酵2–3周；桶熟12个月，15%新桶，蛋清澄清，不过滤。
wines.detail: 西向高台的村庄级单地块 Pinot Noir；不与同名 Chardonnay 或其他生产者的 La Barre 合并。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2024-03，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.85 ha, planted 1992, on the plateau near the Agneux caves; west-facing reddish calcareous soil and clay.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, destemmed and gravity-vatted;3–6 days cold soak,2–3 weeks vatting;12 months in oak,15% new barrels, egg-white fining; unfiltered.
en.detail: Village-level single-site Pinot Noir from a west-facing plateau; distinct from similarly named white wines.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2024-03 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge Chaponnières
wines.place: Rully 北部东向坡：1.67 ha于1985年栽植，另0.56 ha于2016年栽植；砾质钙质土与粉砂黏土坡积物。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、去梗及重力入罐；冷浸3–6日，浸渍发酵2–3周；桶熟12个月，15%新桶，蛋清澄清，不过滤。
wines.detail: 技术单正文标为 Rully 村庄级；PDF文件名中的“1er cru”不作为分级依据。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2024-03，不是酒款年份。

en.place: Northern Rully, east-facing:1.67 ha planted 1985 plus 0.56 ha planted 2016; gravelly calcareous soil and silty-clay colluvium.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, destemmed and gravity-vatted;3–6 days cold soak,2–3 weeks vatting;12 months in oak,15% new barrels; egg-white fined, unfiltered.
en.detail: The document identifies a village Rully; “1 er cru” in the PDF filename is not the wine classification.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2024-03 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Grésigny
wines.place: 0.80 ha，1950年栽植，产区南部白葡萄坡；东至东南向，极多石的褐色钙质土。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨、重力澄清与桶发酵；全桶熟成18个月，15–20%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 该酒18个月熟成，比同庄 Margotés、Raclot 与 Vauvry 技术单所列12个月更长。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2022-07，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.80 ha, planted 1950, on the southern white-wine slope; east/southeast, very stony brown calcareous soil.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed, gravity-settled and barrel-fermented;18 months in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: Its documented 18-month élevage is longer than the 12 months specified for Margotés, Raclot and Vauvry.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2022-07 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Margotés
wines.place: 0.75 ha，1999年栽植，产区南部；东至东南向，白色泥灰岩与多石石灰岩。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨、重力澄清与桶发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15–20%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 栽植年以酒庄技术单1999为准；较早进口商资料曾写2000。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2022-07，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.75 ha, planted 1999, in southern Rully; east/southeast, white marl and stony limestone.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed, gravity-settled and barrel-fermented;12 months in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: The estate gives 1999 as the planting year, correcting the older importer estimate of 2000.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2022-07 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle
wines.place: 进口商记述：1992年栽植，石灰岩伴褐色黏土。
wines.method: 酒庄共通工艺：橡木桶熟成；白酒装瓶前轻过滤。此处不把酒庄共通工艺充作本酒具体年份的完整配方。
wines.detail: 进口商将其描述为同庄白酒中较圆润丰满的一款。官网确认该酒仍在系列中；本次未能读取其独立技术单，故不补造桶熟月份。
wines.vintageScope: 地块与风格为进口商非年份记述；有年份工艺仅适用于注明年份。

en.place: Importer record: planted 1992, limestone with brown clay.
en.method: Estate-wide practice: oak-barrel maturation; whites receive light filtration before bottling. These are house methods, not a complete vintage recipe.
en.detail: Importer style comparison: fuller and rounder. The current estate lists this wine; its individual sheet was not readable in this review, so no label-specific élevage duration is asserted.
en.vintageScope: Importer site/style information is non-vintage; dated technical statements apply only to that vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Vauvry
wines.place: 0.78 ha，1986年栽植，产区南部白葡萄坡；东至东南向，白色泥灰岩与泥灰质石灰岩。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨、重力澄清与桶发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 地块中央有地下水泉出露；酒庄将泉水导向地块边缘后接回自然水道。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2022-07，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.78 ha, planted 1986, on the southern white-wine slope; east/southeast, white marl and marly limestone.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed, gravity-settled and barrel-fermented;12 months in oak,15% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: A spring emerges within the holding; the estate diverted its flow around the plot before returning it to its natural course.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2022-07 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Raclot
wines.place: 0.35 ha，1991年栽植，主坡较高处，位于酒庄 Cloux 上方；东向，白色泥灰岩与石灰岩。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨、重力澄清与桶发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15–20%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 官网目录拼 Raclot，酒庄技术单标题拼 Raclots；保留为同一酒款的来源拼写。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2022-07，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.35 ha, planted 1991, high on the main slope above the estate’s Cloux holding; east-facing white marl and limestone.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed, gravity-settled and barrel-fermented;12 months in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: The estate menu uses Raclot and its sheet uses Raclots; these are retained as source spelling variants.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2022-07 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Préaux
wines.place: 2.58 ha，Cloux 下方主坡下部，东南向；分别于1962、1980及1990年代栽植；砾质钙质土与粉砂黏土坡积物。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、去梗、重力入罐；冷浸3–6日，浸渍发酵2–3周；桶熟12个月，20%新桶，蛋清澄清，不过滤。
wines.detail: 官方分三批栽植的资料取代此前“全部1967年”的进口商概述。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2024-03，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 2.58 ha below Cloux, southeast-facing lower main slope; plantings 1962,1980 and 1990 s; gravelly calcareous soil and silty-clay colluvium.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, destemmed and gravity-vatted;3–6 days cold soak,2–3 weeks vatting;12 months in oak,20% new barrels; egg-white fined, unfiltered.
en.detail: The official three-stage planting history supersedes the older importer’s blanket 1967 estimate.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2024-03 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Cloux
wines.place: 进口商历史资料：约1967年栽植，石灰岩与较轻黏土约各半。
wines.method: 酒庄共通工艺：橡木桶熟成；红酒逐桶蛋清澄清后不经过滤装瓶。此处不把酒庄共通工艺充作本酒具体年份的完整配方。
wines.detail: 进口商描述其酒体充实而协调。旧2022年份资料的25%新桶、12个月熟成仅限该年份，不延伸至当前年份。
wines.vintageScope: 地块与风格为进口商非年份记述；有年份工艺仅适用于注明年份。

en.place: Historical importer record: planted around 1967, roughly equal limestone and lighter clay.
en.method: Estate-wide practice: oak-barrel maturation; reds are egg-white fined barrel by barrel and bottled without filtration. These are house methods, not a complete vintage recipe.
en.detail: Importer description: ample and harmonious. The retained 2022 profile’s 25% new oak and 12-month élevage apply only to that dated record.
en.vintageScope: Importer site/style information is non-vintage; dated technical statements apply only to that vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Clos de la Renarde
wines.place: 0.32 ha，1988年栽植，村内近酒窖，三面围墙；东至东南向黏土粉砂坡积物。
wines.method: 人工采收，依年份去梗或整串，重力入木质截锥罐；冷浸3–6日，浸渍2–3周；桶熟18个月，20%新桶，不过滤。
wines.detail: 官网作为独占园列示。较长桶熟与可变整串处理是其区别于同庄其他红 Rully 的技术特点。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2022-07，不是酒款年份。

en.place: 0.32 ha, planted 1988, beside the cellar within the village; walled on three sides, east/southeast-facing clay-silt colluvium.
en.method: Hand-picked; destemmed or whole-cluster according to year, gravity-filled wooden conical vat;3–6 days cold soak,2–3 weeks vatting;18 months in oak,20% new barrels; unfiltered.
en.detail: Listed as a monopole by the estate; longer élevage and variable whole-cluster use distinguish its cellar treatment.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2022-07 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc
wines.place: 来自 Rully 白葡萄坡上可信种植者的外购葡萄汁；东向，褐色钙质土及黏土坡积物。
wines.method: 桶中酒精发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15–20%新桶，装瓶前轻过滤。
wines.detail: 酒庄小规模 négoce 业务的一级园白酒，不指定单一 climat；与酒庄自有地块的五款一级园白酒分别建档。
wines.vintageScope: 官网链接的非年份技术单；2024-03是文件路径日期，不是酒款年份。

en.place: Purchased must from trusted growers on Rully’s east-facing white-wine slope; brown calcareous soil and clay colluvium.
en.method: Barrel fermentation;12 months entirely in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: A small-volume négoce Premier Cru without a named climat; distinct from the five estate single-climat whites.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet;2024-03 is a file-path date, not the wine vintage.

gaps: 未公开的逐年份变更不作推定。

en.intro: Founded at Rully by Henri Jacqueson in 1946. Paul joined in 1971; Marie took over in 2006 and Pierre joined in 2015. Site-specific red and white Rully wines anchor the domaine.
en.scope: Current estate portfolio and accessible technical sheets reviewed. Non-vintage specifications remain wine-level; document dates are separate from vintages.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: Founded at Rully by Henri Jacqueson in 1946. Paul joined in 1971; Marie took over in 2006 and Pierre joined in 2015. Site-specific red and white Rully wines anchor the domaine.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: About 18 ha across Rully, Mercurey and Bouzeron. Individual holdings and planting dates appear in the wine profiles.

sections.title: Viticulture & harvest
sections.text: Hand harvest and sorting; maturity and fruit health guide picking and pressing. Red grapes travel in small crates.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Oak maturation; whites are lightly filtered, reds egg-white fined per barrel and bottled unfiltered. New-oak shares and duration are wine-specific.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: Official portfolio:12 Rully labels,7 white and 5 red. A generic importer-listed Rully Rouge is retained separately. The unnamed Premier Cru Blanc uses purchased must.

gaps: Unpublished vintage changes are not inferred.

producers.name: Domaine Ninot
producers.intro: Ninot 家族在 Rully 的葡萄种植与制桶历史可追溯至十四世纪。Erell 于2003年返乡，具制桶训练的 Flavien 于2012年加入；兄妹以独立地块酒呈现 Rully。
producers.scope: 已核对酒庄现行目录与可读取技术单；无年份资料按酒款级记录，文件日期与葡萄酒年份分开。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: Ninot 家族在 Rully 的葡萄种植与制桶历史可追溯至十四世纪。Erell 于2003年返乡，具制桶训练的 Flavien 于2012年加入；兄妹以独立地块酒呈现 Rully。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: Rully 的 La Barre、Chaponnière、Le Meix Guillaume 及一级园 Grésigny、Marissou，另有 Mercurey 地块；La Barre 两色分别有独立技术单。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 2020年获有机认证。技术单记载单 Guyot 修剪、抹芽、耕作；采收方式依地块而异，并非所有白酒均人工采收。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 白酒原生酵母桶发酵，红酒技术单列完全去梗和冷浸。Grésigny 桶熟15个月、Marissou18个月；其余本组酒12个月。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 已核对官网7款 Rully：3白、4红。Le Meix Guillaume 从2021年开始独立装瓶，之前用于调配或出售葡萄／酒给酒商。

wines.name: Rully Blanc La Barre
wines.place: 1.66 ha；Mont Palais 山顶约300 m的高地，褐色钙质土及黏土石灰岩底土；1990年栽植。
wines.method: 机械采收，轻压榨，静置12–18小时后以原生酵母桶发酵；228 L桶带细酒泥12个月，不搅桶，10%新桶，不过滤。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述：白果、花香，质地圆润而收结清鲜。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径为2022年，不能把文件年当作酒款年份。

en.place: 1.66 ha on the Mont Palais plateau, about 300 m; brown calcareous soil over clay-limestone; planted 1990.
en.method: Machine-picked; gentle pressing and 12–18 h settling; native-yeast barrel fermentation;12 months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, no stirring,10% new oak; unfiltered.
en.detail: Producer profile: white fruit and flowers, rounded texture with a fresh finish.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage sheet currently linked by the estate; the file-path year is a document date, not a wine vintage.

wines.imageScope: Linked from the corresponding wine on the estate portfolio; label artwork, not a guaranteed current-vintage bottle photograph.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Chaponnière
wines.place: 2.63 ha，Remenot 山脚，东至东南向壤质黏土石灰岩；栽植年份1975、1990、2022。
wines.method: 人工及机械采收，轻压榨，静置12–18小时后原生酵母桶发酵；228 L桶细酒泥熟成12个月，轻搅桶，10%新桶，不过滤。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述：白果与木质气息，酒体较丰满。建议3–7年内结合瓶况判断适饮期。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径为2022年，不能把文件年当作酒款年份。

en.place: 2.63 ha below Mont Remenot; east/southeast-facing loamy clay-limestone; plantings 1975,1990,2022.
en.method: Hand and machine harvested; gentle pressing,12–18 h settling and native-yeast barrel fermentation;12 months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, light stirring,10% new oak; unfiltered.
en.detail: Producer profile: white fruit and oak, with breadth; suggested development over 3–7 years depends on storage.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage sheet currently linked by the estate; the file-path year is a document date, not a wine vintage.

wines.imageScope: Linked from the corresponding wine on the estate portfolio; label artwork, not a guaranteed current-vintage bottle photograph.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Grésigny
wines.place: 0.80 ha，1963年栽植，东至东南向；多石褐色钙质土，底层为中牛津阶白色泥灰岩与石灰岩。
wines.method: 人工采收，轻压榨，静置12–18小时，原生酵母桶发酵；228 L桶细酒泥熟成15个月，不搅桶，10%新桶，不过滤。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述：柑橘、奶油和香草，酸度与酒体并存；建议3–7年内视瓶况饮用。

en.place: 0.80 ha, planted 1963, east/southeast; stony brown calcareous soil over Middle Oxfordian white marl and limestone.

en.intro: The Ninot family’s Rully winegrowing and coopering history reaches the 14 th century. Erell returned in 2003; cooper-trained Flavien joined in 2012. The siblings focus on separate vineyard identities.
en.scope: Current estate portfolio and accessible technical sheets reviewed. Non-vintage specifications remain wine-level; document dates are separate from vintages.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: The Ninot family’s Rully winegrowing and coopering history reaches the 14 th century. Erell returned in 2003; cooper-trained Flavien joined in 2012. The siblings focus on separate vineyard identities.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Rully holdings include La Barre, Chaponnière, Le Meix Guillaume and Premier Crus Grésigny and Marissou, alongside Mercurey vineyards. La Barre’s two colours have separate specifications.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Certified organic in 2020. Sheets describe Guyot pruning, debudding and cultivation; harvesting varies by site, so hand-picking is not assumed for every white.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Whites ferment with native yeasts in oak; red sheets specify destemming and cold soaking. Grésigny receives 15 months and Marissou 18; the other Rully sheets specify 12.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: All seven estate-listed Rully wines are represented:3 white and 4 red. Le Meix Guillaume has its own label from 2021; previously its production was blended or sold to merchants.

gaps: Unpublished vintage changes are not inferred.
